_about: ETHERION 효과음 프롬프트의 공통 말. build_sfx_prompts.js가 카드별 지시(notes/<깃발>.json)와 합쳐 Gemini용 프롬프트를 만든다. 설명은 tools/sfx/PROMPT_SFX.md 5장.
lead: Sound effects only - no music, no melody, no chords, no rhythm loop, no voice or words.
studio: Clean, close, dry studio recording with a short natural tail. Each take is followed by complete silence.
single: Single isolated game sound effect, no music, no voice.

B1.world: goblin and human gunners, fearless black-powder geniuses
B1.palette: black powder, flintlocks and muskets, fizzing fuses, squat cannons, crackling embers, brass casings, scrappy goblin gear
B1.guard: wooden crates, sandbags, dented iron pans, powder barrels, smoke puffs

B2.world: dwarf smiths and the steel golems and automatons they forge
B2.palette: forged steel, anvils, rivets, hissing steam valves, grinding gears, stone-and-iron golem bodies
B2.guard: tower shields, thick iron plating, golem chassis that ring deep, chain mail

B3.world: brilliant, frail gnome scholars who store charge and release it at once
B3.palette: electric arcs, rising capacitor whine, crackling coils, clockwork ticks, glass vacuum tubes, copper wire
B3.guard: humming force fields, crackling energy barriers, sparking coils, brass gadget shields

G1.world: orc warriors riding wolves and bears, strongest when cornered
G1.palette: raw stone, bone clubs, leather and hide, wolves and bears (short growls or snarls only), earth-shaking stomps
G1.guard: hide shields, bone armour, stone thuds, thick beast hide, braced stances

G2.world: moss trolls and treants that regrow when cut and return pain with thorns
G2.palette: creaking timber, bark splitting, roots tearing through earth, thorns, rustling leaves, deep wooden groans
G2.guard: bark armour, rising root walls, thorny counter-snaps, spongy moss cushions, regrowing wood

G3.world: merfolk and water-spirit priestesses who heal allies and wash away enchantments
G3.palette: splashes, bubbles, waves, glassy water drops, conch-like resonance, coral and pearl
G3.guard: water veils, bubble shields, wave walls, coral armour, mist

A1.world: demon pact-makers who pay with their own life for devastating blows
A1.palette: low ominous drones, shadow whooshes, rattling chains, blood droplets, muffled ritual bells, reversed swells
A1.guard: shadow veils that swallow impacts, blood wards, chain rattles, cursed armour

A2.world: seraphs and human knights who take blows for allies and guard them with shields
A2.palette: bright bell tones, radiant swells, silver armour, shimmering light, feathered wings
A2.guard: ringing holy shields, radiant wards, silver plate, glowing halo hum

A3.world: proud, frail high-elf storm mages who twist fate and the wind
A3.palette: rushing gusts, airy whistles, swift thin blades, feathered arrows, rustling silk, distant thunder
A3.guard: wind barriers, deflecting gusts, quick parries, nimble dodges, swirling air

_levels: 유닛 레벨 → 크기 말과 길이(초). atk = 공격, def = 방어
_grades: 등급 → 꼬리에 더하는 말 (없으면 아무것도 안 붙임)

grades.rare: Add a subtle magical shimmer in the tail.
grades.epic: Give it a richer, wider tail with a magical shimmer.
grades.unique: Add a distinctive signature layer that makes it instantly recognisable.
grades.special: Mythic weight: a deep sub-bass bloom and a long resonant tail.
grades.upgrade: This is an upgraded card: brighter and more forceful than its base version.
grades.token: A summoned creature: slightly unreal, with a faint magical edge.

_spell: 마법 길이(초) = base + per × 레벨, 최대 max. 마법의 종류(공격 · 방어 · 공용 · 핸드)는 턴 규칙이라 소리 말에 넣지 않는다 — 소리는 카드별 지시(cast)가 정한다

spell.what: the whole spell, from casting to its effect

item.what: item being fitted onto a unit
